b: Sonisfact’s VOS-82 Overdrive Station puts two drive voicings, Wide and Thick, in one pedal, with a graphic EQ that can sit before or after the drive. Sonisfact describes it as amp-like and transparent enough to work as a boost or as the main drive through a clean amp. Its companion, the VCP-80 Analog Chorus Phaser, covers phaser and BBD chorus sounds from the 70s and 80s. PG contributor Brett Petrusek (@brettpetrusek) plays both and shows what each control does.

The VOS-82's EQ has six bands from 100Hz up to 3.2kHz, and a separate HIT fader boosts or cuts the level ahead of the drive. Thick is the voicing the video’s own caption calls “an OD giving you classic rock tones.” On the VCP-80, the phaser has three modes (45, 90 Vintage and 90 Modern) and the chorus, based on an 80s BBD analog chorus, has Low and High Cut controls for shaping the tone.
